verdict.rationale: Greptile is an AI code review agent, so letting it consume tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents Greptile serving its own MCP server to Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code and Codex. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about, and nothing shows users can plug third-party MCP servers into Greptile's reviews.
